title: Fresh Water & Conservation
intro: Hi! Are you new around here? I'm Ana. Since the last typhoon, our water has come and gone, and last month the tap ran cloudy for a day. My brother says the water we drink comes from a lens of fresh water floating on top of the sea, right under our feet, and that if we pump too much or pollute it, it's very hard to fix.
Our house sits right over it, with an old septic tank in the yard, and nobody has shown me where our water really goes.
Will you help me keep our water safe and enough for everyone, in good weather and after storms?
